Local landscaping

Landscaping in Picton, built for rural and heritage blocks

Picton is not standard suburbia. You have heritage homes near the town centre, rural-residential acreage on the surrounding hills, and blocks that need bushfire and drainage planning done properly. Each is a different job, and we scale the design to suit rather than force a one-size plan.

We come to you, walk the property, and quote a fixed price with no call-out fee. One licensed team covers design through to maintenance.

Get your fixed-price quote

props.label: Section
props.html:
FAQs

Landscaping in Picton: your questions answered

Do you landscape acreage and rural blocks around Picton?
Yes. Larger blocks are common in Picton, and we plan them around slope, access and maintenance so the result suits how you actually use the land.
Can you plan for bushfire and drainage on a Picton block?
Yes. We plan defendable space and proper drainage as part of the design, working to the intent of Planning for Bush Fire Protection. Confirm your BAL rating with the RFS and Wollondilly Council.
Do you charge a call-out fee?
No. Coming out to look at your job and quote it is free, every time. You only pay once you accept a fixed-price quote and we get to work.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes, we are a licensed contractor. We are happy to show our credentials before any work starts, so you know exactly who is on your property.
How soon can you start?
Often quickly, especially for smaller jobs and quotes. We are open 7am to 7pm, 7 days, so call 0451 267 287 and we will tell you honestly what we can do.
